claim.en: According to Aktuality.sk (2024), Martin councillor Marína Gallová is a Slovak national representative in curling.
claim.sk: Podľa Aktuality.sk (2024) je martinská poslankyňa Marína Gallová reprezentantkou Slovenska v curlingu.

findings.identity: Names her as a councillor of Martin; she is a lawyer and bankruptcy trustee from Martin and a member of Martin town council.
findings.quote: Martinská poslankyňa Marína Gallová je reprezentantkou Slovenska v curlingu.
